description: Tool to remove a user from a Calendly organization by membership UUID. Use when you need to revoke a user's access to an organization. Requires admin rights; organization owners cannot be removed.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for deleting an organization membership.

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the organization membership to be removed. This is the membership UUID, not the user UUID.
uuid.title: Uuid

inputSchema.title: DeleteOrganizationMembershipRequest

name: delete_organization_membership

DeleteOrganizationMembershipResponse.description:
Response schema for deleting an organization membership.

On successful deletion (204 No Content), all fields will be None.
For error responses, the response contains error details.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.
message.title: Message

title.description: Error title indicating the type of error (e.g., 'Invalid Argument', 'Unauthenticated', 'Permission Denied', 'Not Found').
title.title: Title
